stories.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
stories.simple_summary: Apple created its own AI assistant specifically for China by working with a Chinese company called Alibaba. This is unusual because the US and China usually don't work together on technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you directly unless you use Apple products in China. It shows Apple is trying to follow local rules in different countries.

stories.title: Educators at an 'inflection point' as AI prompts changes to instruction, lesson planning
stories.simple_summary: Teachers are having to change how they teach because of AI tools becoming available to students.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have school-age children or grandchildren, their learning experience may be changing — teachers are figuring out new ways to use AI rather than just stopping students from using it.

stories.title: We asked Google Geminin AI about incorporating AI in classrooms: here's its response
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI system was asked what it thinks about using AI in classrooms, and it gave an answer.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a news story about what the AI said — nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: China urged to avoid ‘us or them’ split with US over AI governance
stories.simple_summary: China and the US are discussing how to handle AI rules and whether they should work together or separately.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to governments and large companies — nothing you need to act on in your daily life.

stories.title: EXCLUSIVE: Apple trains its own AI model for China market with Alibaba's support, sources say
stories.simple_summary: Apple is training its own AI system for China with help from Alibaba, a major Chinese tech company.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same story as headline 0 — if you use Apple products in China, the company is making sure its AI follows Chinese rules.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is removing a cute yellow character called Mico from its Copilot chatbot because it wasn't working well in voice mode.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Microsoft Copilot, you might notice the character looks different or disappears — this is just a cosmetic change and won't affect how well it works.

stories.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
stories.simple_summary: A company called Writer created a cheaper version of AI software that costs less to use.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to businesses that use AI services — lower costs could eventually mean cheaper AI tools for small business owners, but this is early news.

stories.title: Watch: Fields Medalist Terence Tao on Artificial Intelligence and Why We Do Math
stories.simple_summary: A famous mathematician gave a talk about AI and why mathematics is important.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly of interest to people in math and science — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
stories.simple_summary: A company called Databricks was trying to raise money for AI investments and ended up getting more money than planned, at a very high company value.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows people think AI companies are worth a lot of money, but it doesn't change anything for your business unless you invest in tech stocks.

stories.title: OpenAI is losing its second executive this week
stories.simple_summary: Two important leaders are leaving OpenAI (the company that makes ChatGPT) to take other jobs.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people working at OpenAI — staff changes at big tech companies don't usually affect regular users.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a faster version of its most powerful AI that works 14 times quicker than before.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use OpenAI's ChatGPT for business or work, you might get faster answers soon, but this is mainly aimed at large companies right now.

stories.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
stories.simple_summary: IBM and OpenAI are partnering to train thousands of IBM's consultants (people who give advice to businesses) on how to use OpenAI's AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If your small business hires a consultant, they may soon have training on AI tools — this could help them suggest good AI solutions for your company.
